lead.event: Rupiah hits record weakness as officials respond
lead.headline: Rupiah hits intraday record low of Rp18,188 per US dollar as BI intervenes
lead.blurb: Bank Indonesia said it was supporting the currency through spot, NDF and DNDF transactions and buying government securities in the secondary market. It cited uncertainty over the Middle East conflict, oil prices above US$115 per barrel, rising expectations of US rate increases, emerging-market outflows and higher month-end foreign-exchange demand. The rupiah weakened 1.15% on a monthly basis.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia relaxes reserve requirements for banks
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts banks’ reserve requirements by 2 percentage points
market_structure_policy.blurb: The changes begin on 1 November: conventional banks’ requirement falls from 9% to 7%, while Islamic banks’ and units’ rate drops from 7.5% to 6.5%, then to 5.5% on 1 December. BTN CEO Nixon L.P. Napitupulu estimates the 2% cut could add Rp6 trillion to Rp8 trillion in liquidity for lending.

market_structure_policy.event: Indonesia Stock Exchange advances demutualization and considers Danantara’s share offer
market_structure_policy.headline: Indonesia's exchange advances demutualization with Rp1.56 trillion dividend
market_structure_policy.blurb: BEI approved the plan at its 28 October meeting, setting a special dividend of Rp17 million per share for shareholders recorded on 27 October. Danantara has offered to become a shareholder and is undergoing due diligence, while the mechanism, valuation and timeline remain subject to shareholder approval.

macro_flows.event: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below target
macro_flows.headline: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below Rp30 trillion target
macro_flows.blurb: At the 27 October auction, incoming bids fell 52.05% to Rp31.09 trillion from Rp64.86 trillion on 13 October. The government accepted higher yields, with FR0110 at 7.38%, FR0111 at 7.55% and FR0112 at 7.5%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BRI will run the phase from 22 October to 21 January 2027, following a first phase of up to Rp500 billion from 12 June to 11 September 2026. Shareholders approved buybacks of up to Rp3 trillion on 24 March 2025.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Mandiri extends a credit facility to Jhonlin Baratama
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMRI extends Jhonlin Baratama a Rp40 trillion credit facility
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama had utilized Rp17 trillion as of 26 October, and the facility supports capital expenditure, business development and financing needs in coal and supporting sectors. Repayment is expected from Jhonlin Group operations and subsidiary dividends.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BIPP approved a Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BIPP approves Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bhuwanatala will issue 502.87 million shares at Rp200 each, to be taken up by affiliates Safire Capital and Gratamulia Pratama. The proceeds will support working capital, business development and expansion without changing control. Issuance is scheduled for 4 November, with listing on 5 November.

other.event: Indonesia Stock Exchange approves its first-ever dividend
other.headline: Indonesia Stock Exchange approves first-ever Rp1.56 trillion dividend
other.blurb: Bursa Efek Indonesia will fund the distribution from retained earnings based on audited financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026. Shareholders of record on 27 October are entitled to it, with no payment date reported; implementation awaits OJK approval of the 2027 work plan and budget and amendments to the articles, which also require Ministry of Law approval.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: PT Bank Central Asia reports Q3 results and 2026 loan-growth guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA reports Q3 results and projects 10%–12% 2026 loan growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net interest margin rose to 5.6% in Q3 from 5.3% in Q2. BCA posted Rp45.2 trillion in nine-month net profit, up 4.2%, and projects loan growth of 10%–12% in 2026 after loans reached Rp1,063 trillion, up 12.6%, though it has not formally revised its 8%–10% target.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: Net interest margin rose to 5.6% in Q3 2026 from 5.3% in Q2 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Maha Properti reports third-quarter loss and widening cumulative deficit
earnings_guidance.headline: MPRO reports Rp33.08 billion loss as cumulative deficit widens to Rp245.02 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Maha Properti's revenue rose 44.62% to Rp3.63 billion, while cost of goods sold and direct expenses increased to Rp2.53 billion. Its loss narrowed from Rp54.89 billion in the same period last year.

earnings_guidance.headline: ANTAM reports January–September revenue of Rp88.48 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang’s net profit was Rp9.66 trillion, up 46% year on year, according to three reports, while another reported Rp8.84 trillion, up 47.9%. Gold generated Rp68.41 trillion, or 77% of sales, while nickel segment operating profit rose 82.3% to Rp8.59 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Analysts cite rising nickel prices as a catalyst for ANTAM
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts cite nickel above US$16,000 per ton as catalyst for ANTM
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia analyst Nafan Aji Gusta recommends add with a Rp3,470 target, saying higher prices could lift Antam’s average nickel selling price and margins. BNI Sekuritas maintains buy with a Rp5,700 target and forecasts 2026 net profit to rise 92% to Rp12.4 trillion.
